headline: Weathered Expanse Fighting Persists; Fisherman's Row Lines Shift
war_summary: Fighting in Weathered Expanse has cooled from its earlier pitch but remains the heaviest on the map, with five events in the last two hours and forty-two across the day; Crow's Nest and Frostmarch are the busiest points, and the region stands four Warden bases to five Colonial. Fresh work has opened at Fisherman's Row, where five events in two hours, the latest filed at 17:56, include two bases taken by Warden forces at Oceanwatch and Hangman's Court; that sector now reads seven Colonial and two Warden. Mooring County and Palantine Berm each recorded events at the present hour, Wiccwalk and Leiri Hermanni the busiest points; Wardens hold ten of twelve bases in the former and all seven in the latter. Stlican Shelf has quickened, four events in two hours around Fort Hoarfrost, its lines five Colonial to four Warden. Callahan's Passage, busy earlier, has gone quiet for two hours, with nine Warden bases to one Colonial. Colonials retain the great majority of regions, while Warden colours hold a dozen whole. Enlistments remain brisk in the contested sectors.
